evidence.title: Staff Keycard
evidence.description: A maintenance keycard issued to compound service staff. Grants access to the service wing security node.

evidence.title: Guest Log
evidence.description: A handwritten log of visitors to the estate. Several names recur on the same nights the boats came in.

evidence.title: Transport Manifest
evidence.description: Sealed shipping manifest for unmarked crates delivered to the dock on the same dates as the guest log entries.

evidence.title: Public Statement Draft
evidence.description: A prepared press statement claiming no private security operated on the estate during the summit weekend.

evidence.title: Security Access Log
evidence.description: Printed access-control export showing a private security detail badging into the office wing all weekend.

evidence.title: Security Memo
evidence.description: Internal memo ordering patrols to 'keep the service corridor clear between 22:00 and 02:00.'

evidence.title: Server Archive
evidence.description: Encrypted archive pulled from the estate server. Raw camera footage and transfer records, timestamped.

evidence.title: Broadcast Key
evidence.description: Hardware key that authorizes an emergency override transmission on the compound relay.

evidence.title: Ledger Page
evidence.description: A torn page from a private ledger: shell-company payments routed through the estate, initialed by hand.
